subject: Life Skills
title: Zero-Based Budgeting
description: A quick win: understand Zero-Based Budgeting.

hook.text: He earned $4,000 a month and never knew where $800 of it went. It evaporated into unnamed spending gaps.

buildup.text: Zero-based budgeting assigns every dollar a job before the month starts.

discovery.text: It does not mean spending everything. 'Save $400' is a job. 'Fun money $100' is a job. Every dollar has a destination.

twist.text: The method works because unnamed money always gets spent. If $200 has no label, your brain treats it as available.

climax.text: Start each month by listing income, then subtracting every category until you hit zero. Adjust categories, not the goal.

punchline.text: Give every dollar a name. Nameless money vanishes.

quiz.question: What does 'zero' mean in zero-based budgeting?
options: You spend all your money each month
Every dollar is assigned a purpose, leaving zero unallocated
You start each month with zero savings
